pages.title: Optimus: The concept, before the machine
pages.summary: 2021-08-19 — A humanoid robot program was announced. Control mode not established. A functioning robot was not the demonstrated product.

pages.title: Optimus: A development robot walks on stage
pages.summary: 2022-09-30 — A development platform moved on stage, alongside more integrated hardware. Control mode not established. The stand-mounted unit was not shown walking; task autonomy was not established by the stage sequence.

pages.title: Optimus: Sorting, with a task-level autonomy claim
pages.summary: 2023-09-24 — Object sorting and coordinated body poses in Tesla’s edited footage. Autonomy claimed by Tesla. Tesla calls the sorting autonomous. No independently measured success rate or general task capability follows from the clip.

pages.title: Optimus: Gen 2: revised hardware in motion
pages.summary: 2023-12-13 — Tesla presents new actuators and sensors, revised hands and more capable motion. Control mode not established. Edited demonstrations and relative improvement claims are not a final retail specification or a durability test.

pages.title: Optimus: Shirt folding—and an explicit clarification
pages.summary: 2024-01-15 — A robot folds a shirt in a prepared setup. Not autonomous: disclosed. Musk explicitly said the task was not autonomous at that time. The exact control method is not independently established here.

pages.title: Optimus: Battery cells on a real workstation
pages.summary: 2024-05-05 — Cell handling and walking in manufacturer footage; later featured in Tesla’s Q2 update. Autonomy claimed by Tesla. Tesla describes autonomous handling. A continuous shift, standardized intervention rate and independent task-success study are not supplied.

pages.title: Optimus: An event with mixed control modes
pages.summary: 2024-10-10 — Robots appear among guests, interacting and performing. Mixed control: reported. Bloomberg reported human assistance for some interactions and unassisted walking. Do not label the entire event either fully autonomous or entirely remote-controlled.

pages.title: Optimus: A showroom moment, not a capability test
pages.summary: 2026-10-12 — An Optimus displayed on Tesla’s stand. Control mode not established. A static exhibit does not establish walking, factory deployment or autonomy.

pages.title: Optimus: In the seat, not established as the driver
pages.summary: 2026-10-15 — Optimus was shown seated in the Roadster after the car’s demonstration. Control mode not established. The car’s programmed path is not evidence that the robot drove, steered or controlled it.
